Get webR Configuration Information

Source: R/rw_config.R
rw_config.Rd

Returns detailed configuration information about the R environment running in webR.

Usage

rw_config(raw = FALSE)

Arguments

raw

(logical) If TRUE, returns the raw output as a character vector. If FALSE (default), parses the output into a named list.

Value

If raw = FALSE, a named list with configuration categories as top-level elements, each containing named values. Categories include:

envs

R-related environment variables

locale

Locale settings

sys_info

System information from base::Sys.info()

platform

Platform information from base::.Platform

capabilities

R capabilities from base::capabilities()

r_version

R version information from base::R.version

machine

Machine-specific information from base::.Machine

ext_soft_version

External software versions

r_home

R home directory paths

session

Session information

command_args

Command-line arguments

lapack

LAPACK library information

localization

Localization information

If raw = TRUE, the raw output as a character vector.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get parsed configuration
config <- rw_config()
config$r_version

# Get raw output
rw_config(raw = TRUE)
} # }
